usedFor: CalendarHero holds scheduling contacts and MailerLite holds subscribers, joined by “New Contact Is Added” then “Create or Update Subscriber”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact Is Added” in CalendarHero, then “Create or Update Subscriber” in MailerLite
bestTemplate.why: A person you add in CalendarHero reaches MailerLite without a second entry, since the action creates or updates.

watchOut: “Create or Update Subscriber” updates an existing subscriber, so a repeat contact will not create a duplicate.
